title: Call-sequence fixture (Agent Capability Standard 1.2.0, section 10.4)
description: One layer scope with a person present: tool bindings, then a sequence of calls and events, each call with the outcome a conforming safety layer gives it (section 5.18).

without.description: Features the layer's conformance statement must not list: the fixture pins what a layer without them does (a layer that does not see nested calls, for one). A layer whose statement lists one does not play the fixture.

destination_policy.description: A destination policy in force in the scope (section 4.4.2): the patterns a send's destination must match, which a binding's `destination` pointer locates in the call's arguments. An empty list allows no send. Absent, no policy is in force.

returns.description: What the tool returns as its output, in place of what its output contract requires (section 5.18.10): any JSON value, null included (a present member, whatever its value, replaces the contract's output), given to the layer in the form its host carries a capability output. A nested call's member applies to that nested call alone.

oneOf.description: The call ran (it used its checkpoint and decision) and the layer refused its output (section 5.18.10).
